debit card = a card that takes money straight from your bank account
notes = paper money
coins = metal money
change = money you get back when you pay with too much
keep the change = to let the seller keep extra money as a tip
overcharge = to ask for more money than the correct price
undercharge = to ask for less money than the correct price
complaint = a statement that something is wrong with goods or service
complain = to say you are not satisfied
manager = the person in charge of a shop
customer service desk = the place in a shop for returns and questions
return = to take goods back to the shop
guarantee = a promise to repair or replace a product if it breaks
warranty = a written promise that a product will work for a period
faulty = not working correctly
out of stock = not in the shop at the moment
in stock = available to buy now
sold out = with no items left to sell
order = a request to buy goods; to make that request
click and collect = buying on the internet and picking up in a shop
